title: Department of Public Enterprises hierarchy
subject: Polity
caption: Organizational hierarchy: Government → Ministry of Finance → Department of Public Enterprises and its six units.
altText: An organizational chart showing the Government at the top, linked to the Ministry of Finance, which oversees the Department of Public Enterprises. The department branches into six units: Corporate Governance Unit, Investment Management Unit, Regulatory Affairs Unit, Legal Affairs, Finance & Accounts, and Human Resources.
